'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
***[[Ukraine]] says that its [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|troops]] are still advancing in [[Kursk Oblast]] and now control 74 settlements inside [[Russia]]. The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] says that its forces are fighting the Ukrainians about {{conv|28|km|mi|abbr=on}} from [[Russia–Ukraine border|the border]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-kursk-incursion-we-dont-need-russian-land-2024-08-13/ (Reuters)]
***[[Kadyrovites|Akhmat special forces]] commander [[Apti Alaudinov]] says that the [[Ukrainian Armed Forces|Ukrainian]] advance into Kursk Oblast is currently stopped due to [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[counter-attack]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-keeps-up-air-attacks-kursk-putin-lashes-out-west-2024-08-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[United States support for Israel in the Gaza war]]
***The [[United States government]] approves $20 billion in weapon sales to [[Israel]], including fifty [[McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle|F-15 fighter jets]] and advanced upgrade kits for Israel's existing F-15 jets. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-gaza-20-billion-weapons-us-aid-b6a99129c88a5dcc4a4753e20b5e19ec (AP)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Two [[Hezbollah]] militants, three [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] civilians killed, 21 injured in [[Israel|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s on [[Hezbollah]] targets in [[Baraachit]], [[Tyre, Lebanon|Tyre]], [[Aabbassiyeh]], [[Kfarkela]], [[At Tiri]] and [[Marjayoun]] in [[southern Lebanon]]. Hezbollah launches rockets at [[Kfarchouba]], [[Shebaa Farms]], [[Shtula]], [[Kiryat Shmona]] and [[Beit Hillel]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/13/israels-war-on-gaza-live-10-killed-in-israeli-bombing-of-khan-younis-home?update=3116913 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Israeli crowds led by [[Far-right politics in Israel|far-right]] [[Ministry of National Security (Israel)|security minister]] [[Itamar Ben-Gvir]] storm the [[Al-Aqsa Mosque]] and several villages in the [[West Bank]] on [[Tisha B'av]]. [[Israel Police]] officers reportedly offered protection to Israeli settlers, while the United States and the [[United Nations]] denounce the raids. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/13/israeli-settlers-raid-palestinian-areas-on-temple-destruction-anniversary (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**The [[Houthis]] storm the headquarters of the [[United Nation]]'s [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|Human Rights Office]] in [[Sanaa]], [[Yemen]], and detain Yemeni workers, and seize official documents. [https://www.newarab.com/news/yemens-houthis-seized-un-office-sanaa-un-official-says (''The New Arab'')] [https://apnews.com/article/yemen-houthis-sanaa-un-crackdown-a1dc7c63b4ea61a8ab6fd97230a2739e (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Schools are canceled in [[Puerto Rico]] as [[2024 Atlantic hurricane season#Tropical Storm Ernesto|Tropical Storm Ernesto]] is expected to strengthen into a [[hurricane]] overnight. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/08/13/tropical-storm-ernesto-puerto-rico-forecast/74778350007/ (USA Today)]
*[[2024 Attica wildfires]]
**At least one person is killed and dozens of others are injured in [[wildfire]]s across [[Greece]], with [[Emergency evacuation|evacuations]] ordered for residents in at least one area near [[Athens]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/08/12/europe/greece-wildfires-evacuation-athens-intl/index.html/ (CNN)] [https://www.dw.com/en/greece-1-dead-as-wildfires-bear-down-on-athens/a-69925451 (DW)]
*[[Kiteezi Landfill#2024 landfill avalanche|2024 Kiteezi landslide]]
**The death toll for the [[landslide]] in the [[Kiteezi Landfill|Kiteezi Rubbish Dump]] in [[Kampala]], [[Uganda]], increases to 24. [https://www.dw.com/en/uganda-death-toll-rises-after-landslide-at-rubbish-dump/video-69926235 (DW)]
*[[2024 Sudan floods]]
**At least 68 people are killed in [[Sudan]]'s worst flooding since 2019, impacting several [[Internally displaced person|internally displaced person camps]] amid the ongoing [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-68-killed-sudan-heavier-than-normal-rainy-season-2024-08-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Human rights in Austria]], [[2024 Vienna terrorism plot]]
**[[Austria]]n [[Chancellor of Austria|Chancellor]] [[Karl Nehammer]] announces a package of new [[Counterterrorism|anti-terrorism measures]], including granting Austrian security services the ability to monitor private communications sent on [[Instant messaging|messaging]] and [[Social media|social media apps]] and decrypt [[Encryption|encrypted messages]], and restricting the [[Freedom of assembly|right to assembly]] of groups declared "[[Anti-democracy|hostile to democracy]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/austria-plans-tougher-counter-terrorism-moves-after-taylor-swift-plot-2024-08-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Kolkata rape and murder incident]]
**Thousands of doctors and university students participate in [[walkout]]s and protests against [[sexual violence]] in cities across [[India]] after the alleged rape and murder of a female medical trainee in [[Kolkata]] last week. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-doctors-protest-after-medic-raped-and-murdered/a-69928932 (DW)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Ford Motor Company|Ford]] and [[Mazda]] issue warnings to owners of over 475,000 vehicles with [[Takata Corporation|Takata]] [[airbag|airbag inflators]], cautioning them of the possibility for the inflators to explode with metal shrapnel. [https://apnews.com/article/ford-mazda-do-not-drive-takata-air-bags-explode-3eb0b90b47c9d1417c15704db0b99f80 (AP)]
